Package com.miniandmore.app.web.rest.internal

Class InternalAdminOrderResource

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.web.rest.internal.InternalAdminOrderResource
@RestController @RequestMapping("/internal/v1/admin/orders") @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority(\'ROLE_ADMIN\',\'ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN\',\'ROLE_OPERATIONS\',\'ROLE_CUSTOMER_SUPPORT\')") public class InternalAdminOrderResource extends Object
Admin-only actions for Cash on Delivery orders, which have no online payment step and so need a manual "collected" confirmation once the courier hands over the cash/UPI payment at the doorstep. Zoho Books receives the sales order when the COD order is placed; marking collected records the cash payment.
